Donations will be used to fight climate change, defend wildlife and public lands, and for other
campaigns that allow NRDC to protect the environment in the most effective way possible. Your
tax-deductible donation will automatically be applied towards your NRDC membership.

NRDC (the Natural Resources Defense Council) combines the power of more than 3 million members and
supporters with the expertise of some 700 scientists, lawyers, and other staff to confront the
climate crisis, protect wildlife and wild places, and ensure clean air, clean water, and healthy
communities.

#### Prefer to donate by mail?

Please use our [printable donation form][12]. To donate by phone, call 212-727-2700.

Contact us at [membership@nrdc.org][13] or 212-727-2700.

## Breaking Financial Barriers

We specialize in providing affordable financial products and services for people and businesses in
low-to-moderate income and marginalized communities.

[Open an account][74]

## How Can We Help You Today?

[

### Credit Union + CDFI

CDFI stands for Community Development Financial Institution. It means we’re designed to make loans
in communities mainstream lenders often overlook—and to work with you, not just your credit score.

][75] [

### First-Time Homebuyer Help

Financial assistance and support may be available for first-time homebuyers—or for those who haven’t
owned a home in the last 3 years.

][76] [

### Get Loan-Ready

We look beyond credit scores—but a strong application still matters. Get clear steps to improve your
chances before you apply.

][77] [

### Financial Education & Coaching (Free 1:1)

Get supportive, judgment-free guidance for your money questions. Confidential and free.

][78]

### A Cosmetic and Personal Care Manufacturer Built on Formulation Expertise

Cremon Cosmetics Pvt Ltd started with a simple goal: give brand owners in Gujarat and across India a
manufacturing partner they don’t have to worry about. Our facility at Sanand GIDC-2, Ahmedabad,

personal care products every single day.

We work with a wide mix of clients – first-time entrepreneurs launching a single product,
established pharma and wellness brands scaling a full range, and salons or clinics wanting their own
retail line. Whatever the starting point, the process stays the same: understand the brand,
formulate the product, manufacture it under controlled conditions, and pack it ready to sell.

serum, shampoo, conditioner, toothpaste, soap, hand wash, body wash, gels and ointments for clients

## what makes Davids so good?

### nano hydroxyapatite toothpaste

Davids Hydroxi™ toothpaste uses high performance, naturally derived ingredients and rod shaped nano
hydroxyapatite (nHA) for effective oral care. Click to shop the Hydroxi™ collection.

### fresh breath mouthwash

Davids Hydroxi™ fresh breath mouthwash is non-burning and alcohol free. Our formula uses real mint
oils, xylitol, and premium rod shaped nano hydroxyapatite. Click to shop mouthwash.

### expanding dental floss

Davids Hydroxi™ expanding dental floss is PFAS free, teflon free, and made from 250+ woven threads
that expand to clear plaque and debris from between teeth. Click to shop our expanding floss.

### all Davids oral care products

See the full lineup of Davids oral care products from our nano hydroxyapatite formulas to our tongue
scraper and everything in between. Click to shop the full lineup of Davids oral care products.

### 100 YEARS OF ORAL HISTORY

Dating Back to 1898, Euthymol has been a beloved brand for over 122 years with a long and storied
background of oral care. With a classic design remincent of British Heritage, Euthymol’s DNA is all
about keeping teeth and gums healthy with its fluoride-free toothpaste and oral care products.

Euthymol toothpaste is fluoride-free and formulated with a special blend of natural ingredients to
ensure your teeth still remains clean and free of bad breath. Euthymol a combination of eucalyptus
and menthol, two active ingredients from the original formula from wayback, Euthymol is dedicated to
unique ingredients to fight back plaque and keep your teeth and gums healthy.

### BRIGHT PINK, BRIGHT TEETH

Say goodbye to the sweet minty taste of regular toothpastes and say hello to Euthymol uniquely
flavored hot pink toothpaste that’s both distinct and potent.

### CARE FOR YOUR MOUTH, CARE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT

Euthymol Original Toothpaste is comes in a 100% Recyclable Aluminum Tube. You can keep your mouth
clean and keep Euthymol with your cans when you’re taking out your recyclables.

## About Fluoride

#### What is Water Fluoridation?

Unlike all other water treatment processes, fluoridation does not treat the water itself, but the
person consuming it. It’s outdated, unnecessary, and harmful.

###### [Read More][69]

[What is Water Fluoridation]
[Fluoridated Water is the Main Source of Fluoride Exposure]

#### Sources of Fluoride

Fluoridated water is the largest source of exposure for most people, but it is not the only source
of exposure to fluoride.

###### [Read More][70]

#### Health Effects of Fluoride

Fluoride is a highly toxic substance that can cause a range of adverse health effects. Certain
members of the public are at particularly high risk of harm.

###### [Read More][71]

[Health Effects of Fluoride]
[Stages of Fluorosis Composition]

#### Evidence of Overexposure:Dental Fluorosis

Fluorosis is a defect of tooth enamel caused by too much fluoride intake during the first 8 years of
life.

## About Fluoride

#### What is Water Fluoridation?

Unlike all other water treatment processes, fluoridation does not treat the water itself, but the
person consuming it. It’s outdated, unnecessary, and harmful.

###### [Read More][69]

[What is Water Fluoridation]
[Fluoridated Water is the Main Source of Fluoride Exposure]

#### Sources of Fluoride

Fluoridated water is the largest source of exposure for most people, but it is not the only source
of exposure to fluoride.

###### [Read More][70]

#### Health Effects of Fluoride

Fluoride is a highly toxic substance that can cause a range of adverse health effects. Certain
members of the public are at particularly high risk of harm.

###### [Read More][71]

[Health Effects of Fluoride]
[Stages of Fluorosis Composition]

#### Evidence of Overexposure:Dental Fluorosis

Fluorosis is a defect of tooth enamel caused by too much fluoride intake during the first 8 years of
life.

###### [Read More][72]

[Thousands of Professionals Call for End to Fluoridation]

## Did you know over 1 billion plastic toothpaste tubes go into landfill waste each year?

No, we didn’t either until we started working on Happier Beauty toothpaste. This fact made us
determined to swap single-use plastic tubes for a better option.

Aluminium is one of the easiest and energy efficient materials is to recycle? Nearly 75 percent of
all aluminium produced is still in use today. This means it is one of the most recycled materials on
the planet! Aluminium can be recycled directly back into itself over and over again with almost no
energy loss. This is a true closed loop.

## Your routine deserves
## high quality natural ingredients

Elevate your oral care with premium ingredients that are better for you and better for the earth.
Why is it so normal nowadays to use harsh chemicals and abrasives in your mouth? Happier prioritises
long lasting dental excellence, with materials that don't harm the environment or hang around for
decades in our oceans. From biodegradable eco-floss to hydroxyapatite toothpaste, we're on a mission
to level up mouthcare sustainably.

We understand the importance of oral health and the impact it has on overall wellness, which is why
we prioritize quality natural ingredients that are gentle yet powerful in promoting a healthier
smile. Join us in our mission to make the world a happier and healthier place, one smile at a time.

## Did you know over 1 billion plastic toothpaste tubes go into landfill waste each year?

No, we didn’t either until we started working on Happier Beauty toothpaste. This fact made us
determined to swap single-use plastic tubes for a better option.

Aluminium is one of the easiest and energy efficient materials is to recycle? Nearly 75 percent of
all aluminium produced is still in use today. This means it is one of the most recycled materials on
the planet! Aluminium can be recycled directly back into itself over and over again with almost no
energy loss. This is a true closed loop.
